feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones
entry.summary: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

entry.title: A program in a Texas prison teaches incarcerated women to transcribe braille
entry.summary: The job market is tougher for those with a criminal record. But a Texas women's prison offers inmates skills in braille transcription that could help them support themselves when they are released.

entry.title: Xi Jinping is coming to the White House. Here's what to expect
entry.summary: Xi Jinping arrives in the US this week for an important summit with President Trump. We look at what President Trump and the Chinese leader want out of this visit.

entry.title: In New Orleans, an empty building becomes a free store — and roller skating rink
entry.summary: In the Lower Ninth Ward, an old Family Dollar stands covered in graffiti. It looks abandoned. But inside, it's a treasure trove — clothing, home goods, toys and books. And everything is free.

entry.title: Judge orders Fox to hand over hundreds of documents in shareholders' case
entry.summary: Fox Corp. must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

entry.title: How the NPR College Podcast Challenge changed lives
entry.summary: Tee up those entries: It's time for the next NPR College Podcast Challenge, and hear how the contest changed the lives of past participants.

entry.title: NPR's College Podcast Challenge is back for 2026
entry.summary: Students: It's time to turn on the mic and hit 'record.' Send us your podcasts and we'll pick the best ones. It's $5,000 for our grand prize and $500 for our finalists.

entry.title: Thousands of planned launches, terms of deal, worry some near Louisiana SpaceX site
entry.summary: State officials say the new SpaceX site will be a $100 billion investment and launch thousands of rockets. Lawmakers helped ease regulations and negotiations were covered under nondisclosure agreements.

entry.title: DEI and colleges
entry.summary: The President of Sacramento State talks about their Black honors college -- and how schools are dealing with DEI under the Trump administration. This story was produced with support from the Education Writers Association's Reporting Fellowship program.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
entry.summary: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."
